title: THE KEYS WINDOW NAMES EVERY KEY
why: His order: make sure the key rebinding covers every action. It had most of them, but H (tap to heal, hold for an armour plate), Caps Lock (auto-jog), the two HUD size keys, the two zoom keys and the zoom reset all work in a raid and were not on the list, so none of them could be moved. They are now, in sections (MOVE, FIGHT, WORLD, PARTY and a new VIEW), and a bind onto one swaps like any other. At the bottom the window lists the keys that cannot move and what they do: 1 to 9 pick a gun, P and TAB pause or back out, ESC closes a window, BACKSPACE puts the cursor back, the key left of 1 is Superhot and F11 is fullscreen. The check scans the raid key code, so a key added later without a place on the list fails it.
now: The Keys window now lists every key the raid answers, and the locked ones.
